title: The number of dense-order tuple types excludes equality patterns.
details: Schlicht, An Introduction to Model Theory, PDF dated 2021-07-13, Example 4.1.7, printed p.20, claims exactly n! complete n-types for dense linear orders without endpoints. Already n=2 has three distinct types, realized by (0,0), (0,1) and (1,0) in the rational order: equality, increasing order and decreasing order. The variables were not required to name distinct elements. Quantifier elimination shows that types correspond to weak order patterns, equivalently ordered partitions of the variable positions. Their number is the sum over k of k! times the number of partitions of n positions into k nonempty blocks. The weaker finiteness conclusion is correct; only restricting to pairwise distinct tuples gives n! patterns. This is an adjacent inspected source error; the current types entry does not use the erroneous count.
